purpose: Meter neural module costs and select a smaller profile without losing 0.6.1 stable safety or actuator-fault conservation.

actuator_fault.primary: conservation lease versus no-conservation common-disturbance twin margin AUC

selection_rule.retain_prediction: unless no_prediction exceeds full8 margin AUC in at least 3/4 screening seeds and confirmation does not reverse
selection_rule.retain_recurrence: only if full8 exceeds no_recurrence in at least 3/4 screening seeds and mean gain exceeds explicit recurrence ATP cost
selection_rule.selected_size: smallest candidate whose confirmation mean AUC is not more than 0.02 below full8 and remains above no_tissue
selection_rule.module_retirement: non-positive modules are disabled or placed in dormant profiles; negative findings are preserved
